claims.claim: GLM-5.2 trails Opus 4.8 by only 1% on long-horizon coding (74.4% vs 75.1%) while edging out GPT-5.5 (72.6%).
Z.AI positions GLM-5.2 as delivering state-of-the-art long-horizon coding performance among open-source models.
GLM-5.2 is a 753B parameter, 1.51TB model, similar in size to the earlier GLM-5 and GLM-5.1 releases.
